description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'JpaUtils' which provides a method to execute a JPA query and retrieve a single result, returning null if no result is found, or throwing an exception if multiple results are found.

classes.name: JpaUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for JPA query operations.

methods.name: getSingleResultOrNull
methods.description: Executes the provided JPA query and returns a single result or null if no result is found. Throws NonUniqueResultException if multiple results are returned.
